note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: Pipe-ampersand false grant (glm; found independently mid-round): it is now one operator. Substitution on every path (deepseek, glm, kimi, minimax): the scanner now records the interior of every real dollar-paren or backtick substitution, bare or double-quoted, and any interior matching the commit regex denies the whole command on every path; an escaped dollar and single-quoted text are literals, and a substitution that only reads a message file still grants. Pipe into an executor (deepseek): when no command is credibly a commit, the prefix must sit on the first detector-matched command, and every later command must carry it too unless it is on an allowlist of filters that cannot run their input (head, tail, grep, wc and similar); the allowlist fails toward denying. env with a double-dash false deny (glm, kimi, minimax): the double-dash after env is read through.
findings_refuted_or_deferred: deepseek: sh -c with an unset of the hatch before the commit — a command that writes the hatch and then deliberately unsets it is a deliberate bypass, outside the accidental-grant threat model this fix closes; the hatch itself is always a deliberate bypass.
rounds.notes: 4 of 8 returned verdicts: copilot at monthly quota, codex timed out, qwen truncated to empty, antigravity denied the command permission. Pinned as known false denies: the time keyword before the prefix, and an ANSI-C quoted value. Pinned as a known grant: a hand-typed hatch on a real commit also covers a later pipe of commit text into a shell, kept because closing it would deny grep-then-prefixed-commit. While filing this round the pipe rule first denied an ordinary trailing pipe into tail, which is what added the inert-filter allowlist.
